normalization.source_paths: repository-relative; archived Markdown source links are relative to docs/reviews/gui-capture-preparation with line anchors
normalization.prepared_artifact_paths: archive-member:<name> in JSON; local member names in Markdown
normalization.historical_scratch_paths: historical-scratch: locators; no machine-specific paths retained
normalization.original_preparation_validation_note: validation.json describes original scratch artifact integrity. Its artifact hashes are pre-normalization originals; this manifest records original and preserved hashes separately.

applicability.G2p_branch_erasure_holds: consent display mapping, native sandbox=false arm and erasure POST redirect/action semantics stay unresolved; no fictional confirmed-page golden
applicability.Report_guardian_minor_policy: UI versus direct eligibility, guardian peer-thread versus observer and >3minor shared context remain unsigned
applicability.mandatory_hook_aggregate: fail if existing unit/full requires retirement CLI; classification proposal needs parent/core approval

exclusions: raw transcripts and native chat IDs

licensing_provenance.statement: Preservation introduces no license override. Existing source license/provenance records remain authoritative; archive contains prepared source references/observations, not a new vendored source copy.

verification_scope: archive/member hashes, source hashes, unsigned/unrun invariant checks, docs/whitespace only; no Live/browser/DB/native suite rerun
